steps.name: expect("Create Session timed out after 5m waiting for POST /wd/hub/session. Check the container logs or Selenoid -session-attempt-timeout.").toContain("timed out after 5m waiting for POST /wd/hub/session")

expect("Create Session timed out after 5m waiting for POST /wd/hub/session. Check the container logs or Selenoid -session-attempt-timeout.").not.toMatch("/AbortError/")
expect("Create Session timed out after 5m waiting for POST /wd/hub/session. Check the container logs or Selenoid -session-attempt-timeout.").not.toMatch("/Can't start Android session manually/")
